'''Scott Adams''' is an American cartoonist and author, best known for creating the "Dilbert" comic strip, which satirizes corporate culture and office life. In recent years, Adams has garnered attention for his controversial and conspiratorial opinions. He has appeared on InfoWars as a guest multiple times.

In February 2023, Adams labeled Black Americans as a "hate group" and advised white people to "get the hell away" from Black people, stating, "Just get the [expletive] away. Wherever you have to go, just get away. Because there's no fixing this. This can't be fixed." <ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20250316210259/https://www.infowars.com/posts/video-dilbert-creator-scott-adams-get-the-hell-away-from-black-people-just-get-the-f-away-this-cant-be-fixed/</ref>

Adams has been closely associated with the [[QAnon]] movement. He was the focus of an episode of the [[QAnon Anonymous]] podcast, where his perspectives were discussed in the context of the movement.<ref>https://soundcloud.com/qanonanonymous/episode-43-scott-adams</ref>

Beyond these associations, Adams has expressed numerous additional conspiratorial beliefs. His blog and public statements have delved into topics such as questioning evolutionary theory and the validity of the fossil record<ref>https://rationalwiki.org/wiki/Scott_Adams</ref>.
